title: fix(core): os test --url with a trailing slash addresses the served routes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XFBxyXPUfh7hY87x8YuedEk)_

Fixes #28946

Clause-②: no — no schema, type, export or route change; a `--url` that answered every HTTP scenario 404 now reaches the served routes.

Metadata-protocol: none — nothing a metadata author writes is read differently; `qa/*.test.json` suites are unchanged.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`HttpTestAdapter` 在构造函数里把 base URL 末尾的斜杠一次性去掉,于是发现探针、记录动作 URL、`api_call` 相对路径和报错里的 URL 都读同一个规整后的 base。`api_call` 遇到 404/405 时,报错句末尾追加它实际请求的 `方法 + URL`,和记录动作已有的写法一致。
- 为什么改:`os test --url http://localhost:PORT/`(带末尾斜杠)会请求 `//api/v1/...`,服务端回 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`,每个 HTTP 场景都失败,而且 `api_call` 的报错不说它请求了哪个 URL,看起来像应用坏了。
- 风险与回滚:只动一个类的构造函数和一处报错文案;不加参数、不做 URL 校验,畸形 `--url` 行为不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/core/src/qa/http-adapter.ts` 的构造函数与 `rawApiCall` 末尾;`packages/core/src/qa/http-adapter.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe 与改过的 `[#7983] an api_call failure ...` 用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run src/qa/http-adapter.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 52 passed (52)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/core/src/qa/http-adapter.ts`**: the constructor stores `baseUrl` with its trailing slashes stripped (`private readonly baseUrl`), once. Every URL the adapter builds reads that field: the discovery probe, `collectionUrl` / `recordUrl`, `api_call`'s relative target, and the record-actions provenance clause. `HttpTestAdapter` has one caller (`packages/cli/src/commands/test.ts`, which hands it `--url` verbatim), so normalising in the adapter covers it and any future caller; `Test.run` is unchanged. No flag, no URL validation: a malformed `--url` behaves as it did.
- `rawApiCall` hands `handleResponse` the clause `api_call addressed METHOD URL`, so an `api_call` that fails 404 or 405 ends its existing `HTTP Error STATUS: BODY` sentence with one added clause naming the URL it addressed. The 404/405 gate is the one record actions already use: other statuses reached a route, so the server's own message stays undecorated. `handleResponse`'s parameter is renamed `mountNote` → `addressNote`, since it now carries either.
- **`.changeset/28946-qa-base-url-trailing-slash.md`**: `@objectstack/core` patch with both declaration lines. The CLI is unchanged (its dist imports `@objectstack/core` externally), so it carries no changeset.

## Tests

- New describe at the end of `http-adapter.test.ts`, three rows (`http://localhost:3000/`, `http://localhost:3000//`, `http://localhost:3000/prefix/`) × four cases, against a captured `fetch`: the probe plus the record collection URL carry one slash; an `api_call` relative target carries one slash; the record-actions clause names the normalised base and probe; an `api_call` 404 names the normalised URL.
- The existing `[#7983] an api_call failure is not decorated with a mount it never used` pinned the exact undecorated 404 message. Per the order's ruling it now asserts the added URL clause and still asserts no mount clause. A new case pins that an `api_call` 422 stays undecorated.
- **Ablation 1** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit once, blob `3c016586` → `f4f31939`): the constructor kept `baseUrl` verbatim. 12 failed / 40 passed; for example, expected `http://localhost:3000/api/v1/objects/crm_account`, received `http://localhost:3000//api/v1/data/crm_account` (the doubled-slash probe misses discovery, too). Restored: blob equals HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablation 2** (blob `3c016586` → `43092308`): `rawApiCall` passed no clause. 4 failed / 48 passed (the rewritten #7983 case and the three per-row `api_call` 404 cases). Restored the same way.
- The test imports `./http-adapter.js` from source, so no build sits on the ablation path.

## Acceptance notes

- Measured on a stock showcase boot (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, admin token from `sign-in/email`) before and after, with the showcase's `qa/platform-smoke.test.json` and a two-scenario suite (one `create_record`, one `api_call`):

  | `--url` | base `135054eb` | head `4ff51b55` |
  |---|---|---|
  | `http://localhost:PORT` | 2/2 pass | 2/2 pass |
  | `http://localhost:PORT/` | 0/2, 404 | 2/2 pass |
  | `http://localhost:PORT//` | 0/2, 404 | 2/2 pass |
  | `http://localhost:PORT/prefix/` | 0/2, 404, record clause names `.../prefix//api/v1/data` | 0/2, 404 (the server is not under a prefix), and each failure names its URL: `api_call addressed GET http://localhost:PORT/prefix/api/v1/health`; `record actions addressed http://localhost:PORT/prefix/api/v1/data` |

- Before the fix, an `api_call` 404 printed only `HTTP Error 404: {"success":false,"error":{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found"}}`, with no URL.

## Verification

All at head `4ff51b55` (base `135054eb`, `origin/main` when the branch was cut).
